# LOAD DATA NICHE OVERLAP DATA

## Probabilistic niche overlap (Schoener’s D based on density distributions)

```{r}
Schoener_overlap <- read.csv(safe_input("DP043"))
head(Schoener_overlap)
```

### Create square matrix (niche similarity)

```{r}
summary(Schoener_overlap)
```


```{r}
norm <- function(x) enc2utf8(trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", x)))

niche_sym <- Schoener_overlap %>%
  transmute(sp1 = norm(sp1), sp2 = norm(sp2), schoener_D) %>%
  bind_rows(
    Schoener_overlap %>% transmute(sp1 = norm(sp2), sp2 = norm(sp1), schoener_D)
  ) %>%
  distinct(sp1, sp2, .keep_all = TRUE)

species <- sort(unique(c(niche_sym$sp1, niche_sym$sp2)))

#### Create empty matrix
schoener_matrix <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(species), ncol = length(species),
                    dimnames = list(species, species))

#### Fill upper half
schoener_matrix[cbind(niche_sym$sp1, niche_sym$sp2)] <- niche_sym$schoener_D

#### Force symmetry: copy values from top to bottom
schoener_matrix[lower.tri(schoener_matrix)] <- t(schoener_matrix)[lower.tri(schoener_matrix)]

####Diagonal = 1
diag(schoener_matrix) <- 1

#### Check
stopifnot(identical(rownames(schoener_matrix), colnames(schoener_matrix)))

schoener_matrix[1:6, 1:6]

```


```{r}
#### Check same species and order
stopifnot(identical(rownames(schoener_matrix), colnames(schoener_matrix)))  # same species and order
summary(as.vector(schoener_matrix[row(schoener_matrix)!=col(schoener_matrix)]))

```

```{r}
#### === Export CSV format

          paste0(save_path_matrix, "/schoener_matrix.csv"),
          row.names = TRUE)

```

# DO SPECIES WITH OVERLAPPING SPATIAL NICHES CO-OCCUR MORE FREQUENTLY? – MANTEL TEST

##  Convert Probabilistic niche overlap to distance - schoener_matrix to distance

```{r}
schoener_matrix_dist <- 1 - schoener_matrix
```

## Convert Geometric niche overlap to distance - Jaccard similarity to distance

The Mantel test requires distances (greater = more distinct) rather than similarity values (0-1, greater = more similar).

```{r}
niche_jaccard_dist <- 1 - niche_jaccard_matrix
```


### Align all matrices (same species order)

```{r}
species_order <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  rownames(schoener_matrix_dist),
  colnames(schoener_matrix_dist),
  rownames(niche_jaccard_dist),
  colnames(niche_jaccard_dist),
  rownames(niche_distance_matrix),
  colnames(niche_distance_matrix),
  rownames(cooc_jac_matrix),
  colnames(cooc_jac_matrix)
))

safe_write_csv(
  species_order,
  file.path(save_path, paste0("species_order.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE
)

schoener_dist <- as.dist(schoener_matrix_dist[species_order, species_order])
niche_jd      <- as.dist(niche_jaccard_dist[species_order, species_order])
niche_cent    <- as.dist(niche_distance_matrix[species_order, species_order])
cooc_mat      <- as.dist(cooc_jac_matrix[species_order, species_order])

```


## Co-occurrence vs. probabilistic niche overlap (Schoener’s D) - Mentel test 1.

```{r}
# Co-occurrence vs. niche similarity (Jaccard)
mantel_schoener <- mantel(
  cooc_mat, schoener_dist,
  method = "pearson",
  permutations = 1000
)
```


```{r}
mantel_schoener
```

Species with more similar ecological niches (according to Schoener D) tend to co-occur more frequently, but the effect is moderate.

## Co-occurrence vs. geometric niche overlap (Jaccard) - Mentel test 2.

```{r}
# Co-occurrence vs. niche similarity (Jaccard)
mantel_jaccard <- mantel(
  cooc_mat, niche_jd,
  method = "pearson",
  permutations = 1000
)
```

```{r}
mantel_jaccard
```
Moderate positive correlation (almost strong). Niche overlap based on hypervolumes explains co-occurrence considerably better than Schoener D.


## Co-occurrence vs. niche proximity (centroid distance) - Mentel test 3.

```{r}
mantel_centroid <- mantel(
  cooc_mat, niche_cent,
  method = "pearson",
  permutations = 1000
)
```

```{r}
mantel_centroid
```
There is also a significant, but weaker, relationship. Average proximity in climatic space explains some of the co-occurrence, but less than total niche overlap.

In other words, the pattern of co-occurrence among the benthic species in this study is partially explained by the similarity of their environmental niches, suggesting that environmental filtering plays a role, but is not the only factor.

# PAIRWISE DEVIATIONS FROM THE FITTED GLOBAL NICHE DISTANCE–CO-OCCURRENCE RELATIONSHIP

```{r}
# Residuos de los Mantel tests
resid_schoener <- mantel.residuals(cooc_mat, schoener_dist)
resid_jaccard  <- mantel.residuals(cooc_mat, niche_jd)
resid_centroid <- mantel.residuals(cooc_mat, niche_cent)

# save

safe_save_rds(resid_centroid, paste0(save_path, "/mantel_residuals_centroid.rds"))

```

# RESIDUAL ANALISYS

```{r}
## ----
## normalize names
## ----
norm_species <- function(x) {
  enc2utf8(trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", x)))
}

## ----
## prepare residual df
## ----
prepare_residual_df <- function(residuals_obj, species_order) {
  
  resid_mat <- as.matrix(residuals_obj$residuals)
  rownames(resid_mat) <- species_order
  colnames(resid_mat) <- species_order
  
  # enforce symmetry and diagonal = 0
  resid_mat <- (resid_mat + t(resid_mat)) / 2
  diag(resid_mat) <- 0
  
  message("Matrix size: ", paste(dim(resid_mat), collapse = " x "))
  message("Range: ", paste(round(range(resid_mat, na.rm = TRUE), 4), collapse = " to "))
  
  resid_df_unique <- as.data.frame(as.table(resid_mat)) %>%
    rename(sp1 = Var1, sp2 = Var2, resid = Freq) %>%
    filter(sp1 != sp2) %>%
    mutate(
      sp1 = norm_species(sp1),
      sp2 = norm_species(sp2),
      pair_key = if_else(sp1 < sp2,
                         paste(sp1, sp2, sep = "_"),
                         paste(sp2, sp1, sep = "_"))
    ) %>%
    distinct(pair_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(desc(resid))
  
  return(resid_df_unique)
}

## ----
## classify residuals
## ----
classify_residuals <- function(df, pos_thr, neg_thr) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      sign = case_when(
        resid >  pos_thr ~ paste0("Positive (>", pos_thr, ")"),
        resid <  neg_thr ~ paste0("Negative (<", neg_thr, ")"),
        TRUE             ~ "Neutral"
      ),
      pair_id = factor(pair_key, levels = pair_key)
    )
}

## ----
## summary table
## ----
make_residual_summary <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    count(sign) %>%
    mutate(perc = round(100 * n / sum(n), 2))
}

## ----
## top pairs
## ----
get_top_pairs <- function(df, sign_label, n_top = 10) {
  df %>%
    filter(sign == sign_label) %>%
    select(sp1, sp2, resid, sign) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top)
}

## ----
# residual plot
## ----
make_residual_plot <- function(df, title_text, threshold_abs,
                               low_col = "#540046",
                               mid_col = "#f7f7f7",
                               high_col = "#0F71AF",
                               fill_limits = c(-0.5, 0.1),
                               y_limits = c(-0.5, 0.1)) {
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = pair_id, y = resid, fill = resid)) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = low_col,
      mid = mid_col,
      high = high_col,
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = fill_limits,
      name = "Residual"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = c(-threshold_abs, threshold_abs),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey50",
      linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Pairwise combinations (ordered)",
      y = "Residual co-occurrence",
      title = title_text
    )
}

```

```{r}
## ----
# Main wrapper
## ----
run_residual_workflow <- function(metric_name,
                                  rds_file,
                                  species_order,
                                  save_path,
                                  pos_thr = 0.05,
                                  neg_thr = -0.05,
                                  plot_file_prefix = "residual_spectrum",
                                  fill_limits = c(-0.5, 0.1),
                                  y_limits = c(-0.5, 0.1),
                                  top_n = 10) {
  
  # 1. Load
  residuals_obj <- safe_read_rds(rds_file)
  
  # 2. Prepare
  resid_df <- prepare_residual_df(residuals_obj, species_order)
  resid_df <- classify_residuals(resid_df, pos_thr = pos_thr, neg_thr = neg_thr)
  
  # 3. Summary
  resid_summary <- make_residual_summary(resid_df)
  
  # 4. Positive / negative subsets
  positive_label <- paste0("Positive (>", pos_thr, ")")
  negative_label <- paste0("Negative (<", neg_thr, ")")
  
  pairs_residual_positive <- resid_df %>%
    filter(sign == positive_label)
  
  pairs_residual_negative <- resid_df %>%
    filter(sign == negative_label)
  
  pairs_residual_positive_top <- get_top_pairs(resid_df, positive_label, n_top = top_n)
  pairs_residual_negative_top <- get_top_pairs(resid_df, negative_label, n_top = top_n)
  
  # 5. Export csv
  safe_write_csv(
    resid_summary,
    file.path(save_path, paste0("residual_summary_", tolower(metric_name), ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  safe_write_csv(
    pairs_residual_positive,
    file.path(save_path, paste0(metric_name, "_residual_positive.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  safe_write_csv(
    pairs_residual_negative,
    file.path(save_path, paste0(metric_name, "_residual_negative.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # 6. Plot
  plot_title <- switch(
    metric_name,
    "Schoener" = "Pairwise residuals of niche similarity (Schoener's D)",
    "Jaccard"  = "Pairwise residuals of niche similarity (Jaccard)",
    paste0("Pairwise residuals of niche similarity (", metric_name, ")")
  )
  
  p <- make_residual_plot(
    df = resid_df,
    title_text = plot_title,
    threshold_abs = abs(pos_thr),
    fill_limits = fill_limits,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  safe_ggsave(
    file.path(save_path, paste0(plot_file_prefix, "_", tolower(metric_name), ".png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 9,
    height = 4,
    dpi = 400
  )
  
  return(list(
    residuals_obj = residuals_obj,
    resid_df = resid_df,
    resid_summary = resid_summary,
    pairs_positive = pairs_residual_positive,
    pairs_negative = pairs_residual_negative,
    pairs_positive_top = pairs_residual_positive_top,
    pairs_negative_top = pairs_residual_negative_top,
    plot = p
  ))
}

```

```{r}
p_resid_facet <- ggplot(resid_plot_df, aes(x = pair_order, y = resid, fill = resid)) +
  geom_col(width = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#540046",
    mid = "#f7f7f7",
    high = "#0F71AF",
    midpoint = 0,
    limits = c(-0.5, 0.1),
    name = "Residual"
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-0.05, 0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~metric, ncol = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, 0.1)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Residual co-occurrence patterns",
    subtitle = "Positive = less co-occurrence than expected; Negative = more co-occurrence than expected",
    x = "Species pairs (ordered within metric)",
    y = "Residual co-occurrence"
  )

p_resid_facet
```

```{r}
safe_ggsave(filename = file.path(save_path_figs, "residual_spectrum_facet.png"),
  plot = p_resid_facet, width = 8, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```
